sectionDescriptions.paths: Learn agent engineering from the ground up, one skill area at a time.

/about/.title: About this portal
/about/.description: What agent-interview.icu is, how it relates to CareerPilot, where its content comes from, and how to contribute.

/guides/agent-evaluation/.title: Getting started with agent evaluation
/guides/agent-evaluation/.description: Build an evaluation set, use metrics at each layer, design an LLM judge, and add regression tests so you can measure the impact of changes.

/guides/hallucination-control/.title: Reducing hallucinations in AI agents
/guides/hallucination-control/.description: Constrain responses to available evidence, verify citations, and teach agents when to say they don't know.

/guides/memory-compaction/.title: Compacting agent memory in long conversations
/guides/memory-compaction/.description: Use rolling summaries, structured state, and memory tiers to manage context costs as conversations grow.

/guides/observability-for-agents/.title: Deploying and monitoring AI agents
/guides/observability-for-agents/.description: Understand what your agents do in production with staged rollouts, rollbacks, traces, and cost tracking.

/guides/rag-recall-debug/.title: Troubleshooting low recall in RAG
/guides/rag-recall-debug/.description: Follow five steps to find out whether retrieval missed an answer or ranking buried it. Learn where Recall@k and MRR apply.

/guides/tool-retry-idempotency/.title: Retrying failed tool calls in AI agents
/guides/tool-retry-idempotency/.description: Make tool-call failures predictable with retries, backoff, jitter, and idempotency keys.

/labs/agent-eval-harness/.title: Lab 2 · Evaluate an agent with 20 test cases
/labs/agent-eval-harness/.description: Build a small evaluation harness for the Lab 1 agent with fixed test cases, rubric-based scores, a baseline, and a regression check.

/labs/minimal-tool-calling-agent/.title: Lab 1 · Build a minimal tool-calling agent
/labs/minimal-tool-calling-agent/.description: Build a ReAct loop in about 100 lines with a tool registry, timeouts, retries, and explicit state. Then test it over 100 runs.

/paths/ai-agent-engineer-0-1/.title: The AI agent engineering learning path
/paths/ai-agent-engineer-0-1/.description: Progress through eight skill areas and four stages, from calling an API to designing, evaluating, and shipping reliable agents.

/tool-call-safe-retry/.title: Safe retries for AI agent tool calls
/tool-call-safe-retry/.description: Decide which external tool calls are safe to retry and set limits on retry attempts.
